content:
Leila (Marketing): Quick ask for launch assets — we need a compact bench fig-pack for the blog + webinar.

Hao (eng-runtime): Clarify: model, slices, and variants?

Leila (Marketing): Model: redwood/text-7b-v2 (serving build). Variants: fp16 and int8. Slices: short <64, medium 64-512, long >512, plus a tiny tail slice for rare prompts.

Priya (eng-ml): For int8 I'll attach quant config and model build hash in artifacts.

Leila (Marketing): Metrics: median latency (+95% CI), p99, avg tokens/s, and sample counts per slice. Need PNG + CSV exports and a one-paragraph README describing the warmup policy and variance sources. Deadline: EOD Thu.

Hao (eng-runtime): Plan: 3 replicates per slice per variant, deterministic seeds, warmup probe = 50 sequential requests per worker. We'll compute bootstrap 95% CI for median; capture per-request metrics and sequence-length histograms. Estimated run time ~4-6h.

Sam (product): Add: include exact CLI/job manifest and note: warm path = cached KV; cold path = first request after worker start. Marketing will phrase claims as median+95% CI and p99 tail.

Leila (Marketing): Also need anonymized raw payloads + a small sample of raw outputs for the blog appendix.

Hao (eng-runtime): We'll redact PII and include anonymized inputs. CLI snippet will be in README:```bash
runtime-bench --model redwood/text-7b-v2 --variants fp16,int8 --slices short,medium,long,tail --replicates 3 --warmup 50 --out gs://redwood-marketing/bench/3344556677/
```

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-figpack/3344556677-1 ETA ~5h — https://ci.internal/runs/bench-figpack/3344556677-1

Priya (eng-ml): We'll add model hash, kernel id, quant config, and per-slice sample counts to artifact metadata.

Hao (eng-runtime): Uploading artifacts to GCS when done. Will post link here and drop PNG/CSV exports for designer. If timeline tight we can first push a condensed figures pack and append full artifacts later.

Leila (Marketing): Perfect. Ping when uploaded and we'll pull figures. Thanks all :rocket:
